B19.roi_status: Executor-selected frame0 input patches; not user-confirmed anatomy, rope locations or normal-output regions; static coordinates, no tracking
B19.color_map: OpenCV VIRIDIS fixed LUT; no per-frame or per-ROI normalization

batch2.name: 第二批定向补充B1
batch2.line_proxy: CPU OpenCV LSD standard: sum length of segments length>=40px AND fitted gradient-region width<=3px divided by1024*576; not physical line width or confirmed rope/wire semantics
batch2.boundary_proxy: Mean3x3 gradient pixels / reference union-mask foreground pixels at output resolution
batch2.shape_change_proxy: 1-IoU of adjacent sampled union masks after translating previous foreground centroid to current; no optical flow; shape/pose/occlusion/camera mixture, not proven occlusion
batch2.input_change_proxy: Mean absolute RGB/255 change between sampled input frames6 apart; not measured motion speed
batch2.ordinary_eligibility: Each of line-like, boundary and centroid-compensated shape-change proxies <= remaining27-pool60th percentile; exclude targeted selections
batch2.strata: Eligible pool split at its median input-change proxy into <=median and >median; sorted IDs, seeded sample up to2 per stratum. No replacement if underfilled, no output-conditioned resampling
batch2.disclosure: Inspired by first-batch observations; targeted supplement, not independent initial discovery or unconditional dataset random sampling
